name: dsh-plugins-bundle-mcp-connector
description: Installable dsh --profile patch layer that mounts the durable MCP connector registry, its mcpConnectors RPC controller, that namespace's Client Remote mount, and the Settings > MCP connectors page — adding OAuth 2.0 authorization-code and automatic token refresh for remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers on top of everything dsh-mcp-client already does
